provenance.notes: Read 2026-11-10: the SSD API Fair Use Policy (ssd-api.jpl.nasa.gov) asks for only the requests a use needs, one API request at a time (no simultaneous requests), results stored and reused, backing off after errors, and requires automated applications to send an application-specific User-Agent with the product name, version and contact information. JPL may rate-limit, throttle or block unreasonable load; no figure is published; the APIs may not be embedded in a website (NASA CORS policy). No data licence is stated. Contact: the policy's "contact us" link.
